author: ETA PRIME
description:
This Minisforum MS-A2 build might be the smallest PC you can make while still running a desktop-class GPU. With the Intel Arc Pro B50 16GB, it turns into a legit small form factor workstation and a surprising 1440p gaming machine.

Get The MS-A2 Here: https://tidd.ly/4jPjrJC
3D Print MINISFORUM MS-A2 / 01 + Intel Arc Pro B50 Replacement Shell: https://www.printables.com/model/1530921-minisforum-ms-a2-01-intel-arc-pro-b50-replacement
